newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia reindeer starving after floodwaters freeze.
newsitem.headline: Russia reindeer starving after floodwaters freeze.

text.p: Half of the 300,000 reindeer on Russia's remote Chukotka peninsula could starve to death unless new pastures are found quickly, local officials were quoted as saying on Thursday.

Itar-Tass news agency quoted the head of civil defence in the Far Eastern region as saying that some 700 reindeer had already died because floodwaters on the reindeer's grazing lands had frozen and the animals were unable to find enough to eat.
Several helicopters and groups of workers on the ground were looking for new pastures, the agency added.
Chukotka, across the Bering Strait from Alaska, is home to large numbers of nomadic reindeer herders who depend on the animals for their livelihood.
